description:
Get ready to return to Vice City in the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI. This extended final trailer offers a closer look at Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, the sprawling state of Leonida, and the criminal world, characters, and chaos waiting around every corner.

With an expanded look at the story, locations, action, and atmosphere of GTA 6, Rockstar Games' next open-world adventure is shaping up to be one of the biggest releases in gaming history.

Grand Theft Auto VI is coming November 19, 2026.

Enjoy advanced 4K Upscaling and HDR-10 mastering across future trailers. Stay tuned for more.
